description: Schema for bb system, workspace, and user configuration files (/etc/bb/config.yaml, %ProgramData%\bb\config.yaml, .bb/config.yaml, and ~/.config/bb/config.yaml).

allow_http_update.description: Decide whether bb update may fetch over plain HTTP. false refuses http:// update URLs and --allow-http for every user; true permits plain HTTP for every user. Unset, a user opts in with --allow-http or BB_ALLOW_HTTP_UPDATE. https is always accepted. System configuration or registry policy only.

allow_insecure_skip_verify.description: Control whether insecure TLS verification (--insecure-skip-verify) is permitted. When false, insecure TLS cannot be enabled.

allow_unverified_update.description: Permit bb update without Sigstore signature verification. Last resort; SHA256 checksum verification still applies. System configuration or registry policy only.

allowed_hosts.description: Whitelist of permitted Bitbucket Data Center instance URLs or hostnames.

ca_file.description: Absolute or relative path to PEM Root CA certificate bundle.

default_host.description: Default Bitbucket Data Center instance URL or alias.

disable_bb.description: Disable bb machine-wide: every command is refused except help, --describe, --version, bb doctor and printing a completion script, so a copy a user installed themselves cannot be used. System configuration or registry policy only.

disable_mcp_server.description: Refuse 'bb ai mcp serve' machine-wide; the rest of bb keeps working. System configuration or registry policy only.

disable_update.description: Disable CLI self-update command (bb update) machine-wide.

aliases.description: Host aliases for remote URL matching.

client_cert.description: Absolute or relative path to PEM client certificate for mutual TLS (mTLS).

client_key.description: Absolute or relative path to PEM client private key for mutual TLS (mTLS).

username.description: Username when using HTTP basic authentication.

mcp_ai_disclosure.description: Whether 'bb ai mcp serve' ends the comments, pull request descriptions and tag messages an agent writes with a line saying an AI agent wrote them; on unless set to false. Read from your own configuration file, and from system configuration or registry policy, where it decides for every server either way. Off, the server offers no tool that publishes what the agent wrote under your name at once.

mcp_allow_writes.description: Let 'bb ai mcp serve' expose the tools that change Bitbucket, as --allow-writes does; without it the server offers only the tools that read. Read from your own configuration file only. The read_only policy key keeps the server read-only whatever this says.

mcp_audit_file.description: Mandate where 'bb ai mcp serve' writes its JSON Lines audit trail. The server then audits whether or not --audit-file is passed, and rejects a --audit-file naming a different path. Accepts a file path or the literal 'stderr'.

mcp_elicitation_opt_in.description: Make 'bb ai mcp serve' ask the person in the MCP client before each call of a tool that decides a merge, as --elicitation-opt-in does. Read from your own configuration file, and from system configuration or registry policy, where true requires it for every server and false does not switch it off.

require_keyring.description: Mandate OS keyring storage for credentials and prohibit plaintext config file fallback.

update_base_url.description: Base URL of internal release manifest and asset mirror.

update_signature_identity.description: Expected certificate SAN of the release signer, for organisations that re-sign mirrored artifacts. System configuration or registry policy only.

update_signature_issuer.description: Expected OIDC issuer of the release signer, for organisations that re-sign mirrored artifacts. System configuration or registry policy only.

update_trusted_root.description: Path to a Sigstore trusted_root.json used to verify release signatures offline. System configuration or registry policy only; removes the need for outbound access to the Sigstore TUF CDN.
